kpiHelp.totalSurveys: Number of tasks created within the selected date range, limited to the locations you are allowed to see.
kpiHelp.approvedSurveys: Tasks whose current status is Approved. Counts where a task stands today, not how it got there.
kpiHelp.underReview: Tasks that have been filled and are waiting on a reviewer to complete or return them.
kpiHelp.returnedSurveys: Tasks whose current status is Returned. A task that was returned and later approved is not counted here.
kpiHelp.overdueSurveys: Open fill past the fill due date (Created, Assigned, In Progress or Returned), or awaiting-review past the completion due date (Submitted). Approved work that finished late is not overdue.
kpiHelp.activeTeams: Distinct field teams currently holding at least one task in the range. Teams with no work are not counted.
kpiHelp.completionRate: Approved tasks ÷ total tasks, as a percentage.
kpiHelp.onTimeRate: Of completed tasks, the share that met both clocks: fill by the fill due date and approval by the completion due date. A missing deadline counts as on time for that clock.
kpiHelp.returnRate: Tasks that have been returned at least once ÷ total tasks, as a percentage. Unlike the Returned card, this counts history rather than current status.
kpiHelp.avgCompletion: Average hours from the moment a task was allocated to a team until it was completed. Tasks missing either timestamp are excluded rather than counted as zero.

panelHelp.trend: Counts status changes recorded in the task history, grouped by the selected interval. A task moving through several statuses contributes one point at each step, so the totals here are larger than the task count.
panelHelp.statusDistribution: How the tasks in the selected range split across their current status. Statuses with no tasks are hidden.
panelHelp.transactions: The most recent status changes across the tasks you are allowed to see — who moved what, and when.
panelHelp.teamsByOrg: Team coverage comes from the org scope assigned to each team, applied downwards: a team scoped to a CBU counts toward every branch and operation area beneath it. "Teams" is coverage on paper; "Working" is how many actually hold a task in the range.
panelHelp.teamsByDepartment: The same coverage figures grouped by department, based on the departments assigned to each team.
panelHelp.myPerformance: Your own recorded status changes within the selected range. "Transactions" counts every change you made; "Tasks Handled" counts the distinct tasks behind them.
panelHelp.vsPeers: Ranks everyone in the selected comparison group by the number of status changes they made in the range. Percentile is the share of the group below you, so the lowest — or a group of one — reads 0%.
panelHelp.lateSurveys: Tasks that missed their due date. "Overdue" means still open and past due — work to chase now. "Finished Late" means it was completed after the due date. Days Late counts to today for overdue work, and to the completion date for finished work. Tasks with no due date can never be late and are not listed.
panelHelp.lateTeams: The same lateness grouped by the team that held each task. Only teams with at least one late task appear. Average Days Late is measured over that team’s late tasks only, so clean work does not dilute it. On-Time Rate covers the tasks they completed.
